# Fallout 76 “Burning Springs” patch notes from December 2nd, 2025 (Patch 64)

![Fallout 76 `Burning Springs` patch notes from December 2nd, 2025 (Patch 64)](/uploads/592_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

# Fallout 76: Burning Springs update notes

December 2, 2025

Grab your duster, your hat, and your favorite weapon, because it's time to go bounty hunting! Explore our largest map expansion yet and claim some of the biggest bounties Burning Springs has to offer.
### Welcome to Ohio

## Update highlights

**Bounty Hunts** - Grab your duster, your cowboy hat, and your favorite weapon, because it's time to go bounty hunting!
**Explore Burning Springs** - Cross the Point Pleasant Bridge to enter a land of rust and blood. Discover our biggest map expansion yet!
**An Audience with the King** - Prove yourself to the Rust King, the merciless ruler of Burning Springs, and launch an all-new story in Fallout 76.
**New Public Events** - Participate in two new public events: Well Equipped and Sink Battle.
**Awesome new pet** - Bring home a new friend from the wasteland: a RAD Boar!
**Season 23: Blood and Rust** – A season for raiders.

## Update version 1.7.22.12 and download sizes

- PC (Steam): 28.8GB
- PC (Microsoft Store): 39.3GB
- Xbox: 41.9GB
- PlayStation: 40.8GB

A new region of the map is open to all who dare to cross the Point Pleasant Bridge. It's time to head west: to Burning Springs. Our largest map expansion to date for Fallout 76 takes you to rural Ohio. The Burning Springs update brings bounty hunting to Fallout 76 and the chance to become one of the wasteland's most feared bounty hunters. This new content gives you the opportunity to seek out and eliminate some of the area's greatest threats. We're thrilled to announce that the Ghoul from the Fallout TV series on Amazon Prime is joining us in Burning Springs. With the voice of Walton Goggins (in the English version), the ghoul introduces you to the world of bounty hunting.
The The main quest for Burning Springs is just the beginning of your story in this new region. In this first chapter of a story split across multiple updates, you'll meet various characters who will guide you through the new story. Featuring a new quest line, two new public events, the new bounty hunting feature and a range of additional content (including new fish and regional legends for you to catch), "Burning Springs" is our biggest update to date since "Wastelanders" in 2020. Burning Springs, a region in southeastern Ohio, was not only affected by the nuclear strikes but also devastated by toxic chemicals from an Abraxodyne Chemical factory. Now the area is a desolate, barren wasteland where the water is polluted and dust storms cover everything with a poison called "the rust." Who would want to call this land home? The Rust King.The Rust King, a super mutant with as much brains as he does brawn, is the relentless and unforgiving ruler
